notes:
• FinUtopia is now Taka (টাকা in Bangla). The app name follows your phone's language. It updates over the old app and keeps all your data.

• Home and Wealth now highlight your available balance: the money in cash, wallets, bank and prepaid accounts that you can spend. Net worth is shown just below it.

• The app icon now sits at the top of Home. The back up now button is gone; backups run by themselves.

• Choose how often backups run: every day, every week or every month, for Google Drive and for the backup folder.

• Savings goals on Home have a + button, so you can add money to a goal right there.

• A DPS on the Savings tab now shows how much you have saved and how many instalments are paid.

• When you pay an EMI, type the principal and interest your lender actually charged. A prepayment can include interest too.

• Reports: tap Preview PDF to see the report before you save or share it.

• Settings is grouped into cards, and About tells you more about the app.

• New categories: Food, Snacks and tea, and Subscriptions. New income sources: Bank cashback and MFS cashback.

• Bank credit ratings are removed, because there is no live source for them. The warning above the Tk 2 lakh protected per bank stays.

• The app now starts in the light theme.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.2.25 or newer cannot be restored on an older version.
